faqs.question: How quickly can you buy my house in Greenwich?
faqs.answer: We can complete a purchase anywhere in the Royal Borough of Greenwich in as little as seven days. Our average completion time is fourteen days. The exact timeline depends on your circumstances and how quickly your solicitor can process the legal paperwork. You choose the completion date that suits you best.

faqs.question: Do you charge any fees to sell my Greenwich property?
faqs.answer: No. Sell My House Fast Greenwich covers all costs, including legal fees. There are no estate agent commissions, no survey costs, and no hidden charges. The cash offer we make is the amount you receive on completion day, with nothing deducted.

faqs.question: How do you calculate your offer on my Greenwich home?
faqs.answer: We base our offers on current market data, recent comparable sales in your specific Greenwich neighbourhood, and the condition of your property. Our team has deep local knowledge of areas from Blackheath to Abbey Wood, which ensures our valuations accurately reflect the local market.

faqs.question: Will World Heritage Site restrictions affect the sale of my Greenwich property?
faqs.answer: Not when selling to us. Properties near the Maritime Greenwich UNESCO World Heritage Site can be harder to sell traditionally because buyers worry about planning restrictions. As cash buyers, we purchase properties regardless of heritage designations and do not require planning permissions or mortgage lender approvals to complete.

faqs.question: How is the Woolwich Arsenal regeneration affecting property sales?
faqs.answer: The Woolwich Arsenal regeneration has created significant construction disruption for nearby residents, making some properties harder to sell on the open market. Buyers may be deterred by ongoing works. We buy properties throughout Woolwich regardless of proximity to the regeneration zone and are not affected by construction timelines.

faqs.question: Is flood risk along the Thames a problem when selling my house?
faqs.answer: Flood risk near the Thames can complicate traditional sales because mortgage lenders may refuse to lend on properties in higher-risk zones. As cash buyers, we do not rely on mortgage finance, so we can purchase Thames-side properties in Greenwich, Charlton, and Woolwich without flood risk affecting the transaction.

faqs.question: Has the Elizabeth line affected property prices in Abbey Wood?
faqs.answer: The Elizabeth line has significantly boosted property values in Abbey Wood and Woolwich, with improved connectivity to Canary Wharf, the West End, and Heathrow. If you want to capitalise on increased values by selling quickly for cash, we can provide a fair offer reflecting the current uplift in the local market.

faqs.question: Can you buy my property in the Blackheath Conservation Area?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We regularly purchase properties within the Blackheath Conservation Area. Conservation restrictions that deter traditional buyers, such as limitations on external alterations and requirements for specific building materials, do not affect our ability to buy your home for cash.

faqs.question: Do you buy ex-council properties in Greenwich?
faqs.answer: Yes. We buy ex-council and ex-local-authority properties throughout Greenwich, including in Woolwich, Plumstead, and Eltham. Non-standard construction types and short leases that can prevent mortgage approval are not obstacles for our cash buying service.

faqs.question: What types of property do you buy in Greenwich?
faqs.answer: We buy every type of residential property across the Royal Borough, including flats, terraced houses, semi-detached and detached homes, bungalows, and maisonettes. From period properties in Greenwich Town Centre to new-builds near Abbey Wood station, no property type is excluded.

faqs.question: Can I sell my Greenwich house if it needs major repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We buy properties in any condition, from homes needing minor cosmetic updates to those requiring complete structural renovation. You do not need to spend any money on repairs or improvements before selling to us. We will make a fair offer based on the property's current state.

faqs.question: What if I am facing repossession on my Greenwich home?
faqs.answer: We can often help homeowners facing repossession by completing a fast cash purchase before the lender takes possession. Time is critical in these situations, so contact us on 0800 012 1043 as soon as possible. Our seven-day completion capability has helped numerous Greenwich homeowners avoid repossession.

faqs.question: Do I need to have my Greenwich property valued before contacting you?
faqs.answer: No. We provide a free, no-obligation valuation as part of our service. Our Greenwich property experts will assess your home using current local market data and comparable sales from your specific area. You do not need to arrange any independent valuations or surveys before getting in touch.

faqs.question: Can I stay in my Greenwich property after selling to you?
faqs.answer: In some cases, we can arrange a short-term rent-back agreement, allowing you to remain in the property for an agreed period after completion. This can be helpful if you need time to find your next home. Discuss your requirements with our team and we will do our best to accommodate you.

faqs.question: How do I get started with selling my Greenwich house fast?
faqs.answer: Simply call us on 0800 012 1043 or complete the short form on our website at sellmyhousefastgreenwich.co.uk. We will ask a few basic questions about your property and provide a no-obligation cash offer within twenty-four hours. There is no cost and no pressure at any stage.
